description: Executable Candidate adaptation of MiaAI-Lab's public one-DGX-Spark Ling 3.0 Flash SGLang profile, with the target and external DSpark draft fully hydrated before an offline launch. The pinned upstream full-context profile measures mem-fraction-static 0.80 at 262144 context with a 328898-token KV pool, about 12.5 GB of KV memory, 22.0 GB free GPU-side memory after graphs, and about 20 GB host MemAvailable. Vonk conservatively budgets 119 GB startup, 114 GB steady state, 5 GB runtime growth, and 7 GB system reserve for an exact 126 GB admission envelope; physical Vonk acceptance remains pending.
title: Ling 3.0 Flash INT4 SGLang DSpark single Spark
